title: Hillel, Disciple of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Beitzah 26b he asks Rava a question. In Pesachim 115a, Ravina says, “Rav Mesharshya, son of Rav Natan, told me: This is what Hillel said from received tradition.” In Nazir 44b and Gittin 37a, too, “Hillel taught.” Hyman suggests that this may be Rava’s disciple; Rashi there explains that he was an Amora.

notes.text: The opening כ is a citation preposition, not 20; שבעי means “who asked,” not a person called Shevai. Beitzah 26b explicitly names Hillel asking Rava.
